name: Default
shortDescription: Visual chatbot builder with a separate viewer that serves published bots, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign-in needs an auth provider. Add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and NEXT_PUBLIC_SMTP_FROM (or an OAuth provider) to the environment, plus ADMIN_EMAIL set to your address for an unlimited workspace, then redeploy. Do not leave any of these keys empty: the app refuses to start on an empty value.
Published bots are served on bot.<your-domain>, so that hostname needs a DNS record pointing to this server as well.
